<skill_content name="velaguard-alarm-to-screen">
# Skill: velaguard-alarm-to-screen
# VelaGuard 告警上屏

本地安全环：采集已确认点表 → `vg_alarm_eval` 比较 → 告警页弹出 → 写入 `/data/velaguard/pending_alarm.txt`。断网也要成立，不经 MQTT 下发，不依赖 Agent。

实现：[`app/velaguard/vg_alarm_eval.c`](../../../app/velaguard/vg_alarm_eval.c)。字段口径：[`docs/velaguard-host-nsh-protocol.md`](../../../docs/velaguard-host-nsh-protocol.md) 第 4 节。术语：[`CONTEXT.md`](../../../CONTEXT.md) 的 Local Safety Loop / Offline / Recovering。

点表怎么写到板上，走 `velaguard-candidate-confirm`。本 Skill 假定已确认表已经带 `cmp` / `warn` / `crit`。

## 比较规则

只读已确认表。**不得**按点名称认水浸 / 烟雾。

- `cmp` 为空，或 `ge`/`le` 且 `warn` 与 `crit` 都空：只采集，不做模拟量告警。
- `eq`：用 `crit` 做等于判定（例如水浸等于 1）。`warn` 可空。
- `ge` / `le`：有 `warn` 则预警，有 `crit` 则严重。两者都有时，`ge` 要求 `warn <= crit`，`le` 要求 `warn >= crit`。
- 离线按滑窗失败率判定：最近 8 轮采集（板端一轮约 200 ms）内失败达 `max(fail_n, 5)` 轮（上限 8）才记 Offline，告警种类为离线；零星抖动不误判，拔线约 1 s 触发。
- 严重优先于离线，离线优先于预警（`vg_alarm_kind_rank`）。

HMI 在 `vg_model_set_live` 路径上调用 `vg_alarm_eval`，命中则 `vg_pending_alarm_write`。

## 落盘与上屏

- 告警正文：`/data/velaguard/pending_alarm.txt`
- 屏幕自己读这份文件并弹出告警页；不要走 MQTT、不要等 Agent
- 日报 / 报告页读 `/data/velaguard/reports`，与待处理告警不是同一条路径
- 告警所属点恢复正常（在线读数回 `NONE`）时，HMI 清 `s_alarm` 并 `unlink` 待处理文件；Agent HEARTBEAT 也会删同一文件，两边都删不算错

## 明确不做

OTA、周报、规则库、开机同时拉起 HMI 和 Agent。Agent 解读告警是后一步（seed Skill `alarm_interpretation.md`），不能代替本闭环。

## 板测最小闭环

固件：作品主线 `velaguard-lvgl`。先用 `velaguard-candidate-confirm` 灌一张带阈值的已确认表。

1. 首页能列出已确认点（`nsh> vgpoint list` 点数与屏上一致）。
2. 注入：把模拟量打到 `warn`/`crit` 之外，或拔掉 485 / 关掉从站。
3. 告警页弹出（目视）。
4. `ls /data/velaguard/pending_alarm.txt` 文件存在。

Host 逻辑：`make -C app/velaguard/host_tests test`（含 `test_vgpoint`）。不要用按名称分支的旧告警路径。

Relative paths in this skill are relative to this base directory.

# VelaGuard GUI exploration report

## Root cause in one line

The model holds exactly ONE alarm: `static vg_alarm_t s_alarm;` at `/home/hello19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/gui/main/ui/model/vg_model.c:39`, and the alarm-set path (`vg_model_set_live`, lines 1733–1749) replaces `s_alarm` whenever a NEW point alarms with equal-or-higher rank (`vg_alarm_kind_rank`: crit > offline > warn). Two points alarming at once = only the highest-ranked one survives; the other is silently dropped. The alarm page renders only that single struct.

---

## 1. GUI source tree layout

All app UI lives under `/home/hello19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/gui/main/ui/` (LVGL v9 is a submodule at `gui/lvgl/`; screen is 480x272, constants in `gui/main/inc/vg_display.h`):

- `gui/main/ui/app/vg_app.c` — `vg_app_init()` (line 103): `vg_theme_init(); vg_model_init(); vg_shell_create(); vg_nav_goto(VG_PAGE_HOME, NULL);`
- `gui/main/ui/shell/vg_shell.c` + `vg_shell.h` — status bar, nav stack, toast, page dispatch
- `gui/main/ui/pages/vg_pages.h` — page IDs enum + `vg_page_*_create` prototypes (in `vg_shell.h:10-23` actually: `VG_PAGE_HOME…VG_PAGE_DISCOVER`)
- `gui/main/ui/pages/vg_page_alarm.c` — the alarm page (319 lines, read in full)
- `gui/main/ui/pages/vg_page_home.c` — confirmed-points grid + filter chips
- `gui/main/ui/pages/vg_page_logs.c` — scrollable row-list example
- `gui/main/ui/model/vg_model.c` (1840+ lines) + `vg_model.h` — model/state
- `gui/main/ui/model/vg_ui_backend.c/.h` — sim backend stub; board backend is `app/velaguard/vg_ui_backend_board.c` (compiled in place of `vg_ui_backend.c`, see Makefile filter below)
- `gui/main/ui/widgets/vg_widgets.c/.h` — `vg_status_chip_*`, `vg_metric_row_*`, `vg_risk_badge_*`
- `gui/main/ui/widgets/vg_confirm_dialog.c` — modal confirm dialog
- `gui/main/ui/theme/vg_theme.c/.h` — colors, severity enum, style appliers
- `gui/main/ui/fonts/` — `vg_font_ui()`, `vg_font_small()`, `vg_font_metric()`

## 2. Status bar alarm indicator — `gui/main/ui/shell/vg_shell.c`

- Created at lines 170–174 in `vg_shell_create()`:
```c
/* ALARM chip (manual 16.8): always shown; tap opens alarm/AI page. */
s_chip_alarm = make_chip(s_status_bar, "告警", VG_SEV_OK);       // line 172
lv_obj_add_flag(s_chip_alarm, LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE);            // line 173
lv_obj_add_event_cb(s_chip_alarm, alarm_chip_clicked, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, NULL); // 174
```
- Click handler (lines 73–77): `alarm_chip_clicked()` → `vg_nav_goto(VG_PAGE_ALARM, NULL);`
- State driving it — `refresh_alarm_chip()` (lines 288–317): reads `vg_model_get_active_alarm()`; inactive → label “告警”， transparent bg; active → `set_chip(s_chip_alarm, "告警!", a->severity)`, muted/dimmed when `a->acked || a->muted` (lines 306–316).
- Refresh path: model change listeners. `vg_shell_create()` registers `vg_model_on_change(model_changed, NULL)` (line 215) → `vg_shell_refresh_status()` (line 319) → `refresh_alarm_chip()`. A 1 s `lv_timer` (`s_model_tmr`, line 212) calls `vg_model_tick()` which calls `notify_all()` when dirty, so the chip also refreshes every second.

## 3. Alarm page — `gui/main/ui/pages/vg_page_alarm.c`

Created by `vg_page_alarm_create(lv_obj_t * parent, const void * args)` (line 221), dispatched from `create_page()` in `vg_shell.c:348-351` (title “告警详情”). Static UI context `alarm_ctx_t s_alarm_ui` (lines 9–21).

Build (lines 221–318):
- `head` card (lines 236–257): `s_alarm_ui.title` label + `vg_status_chip_create(head, "正常", VG_SEV_OK)` (line 257)
- `body` scrollable card (lines 259–270): `LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLLABLE` + `LV_DIR_VER` + scrollbar auto — this is the natural host for a multi-row list
- “规则摘要” AI text: `ai_head` (273) + wrapping `ai_lab` (278–284)
- Six fixed metric rows (lines 286–291): `vg_metric_row_create(body, "类型/当前值/阈值/持续/传感器/状态", "--")` → `s_alarm_ui.rows[0..5]`
- `hist_lab` history label (293–298)
- `actions` row (300–314): `make_btn()` (206–219, `lv_button_create`, 140x36, `vg_style_apply_btn`) creates `btn_mute` “静音” (313) and `btn_ack` “标记处理” (314)

Content source and single-alarm rendering — `refresh_alarm(void * user)` (lines 43–183), registered via `vg_model_on_change(refresh_alarm, NULL)` at line 316:
```c
a = vg_model_get_active_alarm();                    // line 58 — single struct only
...
if(a->active) {
    lv_label_set_text(s_alarm_ui.title, a->title);                       // 80
    vg_status_chip_set(s_alarm_ui.chip, vg_severity_label_zh(a->severity), a->severity); // 81
    vg_metric_row_set_value(s_alarm_ui.rows[1], buf);  // value "v unit"  92-93
    vg_metric_row_set_value(s_alarm_ui.rows[4], as ? as->name : "--");   // point name, 102
    vg_metric_row_set_value(s_alarm_ui.rows[5],
        a->acked ? "已处理" : (a->muted ? "已静音" : "活动中"));           // 103-104
```
It does NOT read `/data/velaguard/pending_alarm.txt` — the GUI reads model state only. The file is written/cleared by the app layer: `app/velaguard/vg_ui_backend_board.c` lines 768–796 inside `vg_ui_backend_apply_live()` — when `vg_model_get_active_alarm()->active` it formats one alarm (`type=%s\ntag=%s\n...`) and calls `vg_pending_alarm_write(buf)` (line 790); on the active→inactive edge it calls `vg_pending_alarm_clear()` (line 793, `unlink` in `app/velaguard/vg_agent_alarm.c:115-119`). Since only one `s_alarm` exists, only one alarm ever lands in that file.

Page lifecycle: `on_alarm_delete` (199–204) unregisters the listener on `LV_EVENT_DELETE`; guard `if(vg_nav_current() != VG_PAGE_ALARM) return;` at line 55.

## 4. Ack / mute today (per-alarm actions do NOT exist)

- Handlers: `on_mute` (185–190) → `vg_model_mute_alarm()` + `vg_shell_toast("已静音")`; `on_ack` (192–197) → `vg_model_ack_alarm()` + toast “已标记处理”. Buttons disable when already acked/muted (152–167).
- Model side, `vg_model.c:1409-1423`:
```c
void vg_model_ack_alarm(void)  { if(!s_alarm.active || s_alarm.acked) return; s_alarm.acked = true; ... notify_all(); }
void vg_model_mute_alarm(void) { if(!s_alarm.active) return; s_alarm.muted = true; ... notify_all(); }
```
- That is all they do: set flags on the single global alarm. No unlink of `pending_alarm.txt` from the GUI, no per-point state, no buzzer hook (`vg_hmi.c` has zero mute/buzzer/alarm references). Alarm auto-clears only when the owning point's reading returns to `VG_ALARM_KIND_NONE` (`vg_model_set_live`, vg_model.c:1707–1715) or on point-table re-import (1623–1626). Mute affects only the status chip dimming (`vg_shell.c:307-309`). Home page also has a quick-mute (`vg_page_home.c:312-325` `on_mute`).

## 5. Reusable list/row/card patterns

- Home confirmed-points grid, `vg_page_home.c`: scroll container recipe `s_home.list` (lines 405–419: flex column, `flex_grow=1`, `min_height=0`, vertical scroll, no elastic); tile rows `make_sensor_tile()` (130–179, 36 px touch height, severity left-border 4px, zebra bg, `CLICKABLE`); `make_pair()` (182–195); rebuild-on-signature pattern `build_list_sig`/`rebuild_list`/`update_tile_texts` (89–273) — rebuilds children only when the visible set changes, otherwise in-place text refresh. This sig-based rebuild is the pattern to copy for an alarm list.
- Logs rows, `vg_page_logs.c`: `make_log_row()` (lines 20–47) — full-width obj, bottom border, `LV_SIZE_CONTENT` height; list card at 100–110 (`vg_style_apply_card` + scroll).
- Alarm page's own `body` card (vg_page_alarm.c:259–270) is already scrollable.
- Buttons: `make_btn()` (vg_page_alarm.c:206–219), `make_action()` (vg_page_home.c:334–346).
- Widgets: `vg_metric_row_create/set_value` (`vg_widgets.c:31-62`), `vg_status_chip_create/set` (`vg_widgets.c:7-29`).
- Styles/theme: `vg_style_apply_card` (`vg_theme.c:118`), `vg_style_apply_btn` (`:131`), `vg_style_apply_chip` (`:154`), `vg_color_severity()`; constants in `vg_display.h` (`VG_MIN_TOUCH_H 36`, `VG_CARD_RADIUS 4`, `VG_DISP_W 480 / VG_DISP_H 272`, `VG_STATUS_H 28`).

## 6. Model / state layer

- `vg_alarm_t` struct: `vg_model.h:104-114` — `active, severity, title[64], sensor_id[24], value, threshold, duration_sec, acked, muted`. Single instance `s_alarm` at `vg_model.c:39`.
- Set paths: `set_alarm_from_sensor()` (`vg_model.c:1002-1015`) always `memset`s `s_alarm` first. Called from scenario seeds (1080, 1103, 1124) and from `vg_model_set_live()` (`vg_model.c:1664-1823`) with the rank-guard at 1733–1749 (threshold) and 1794–1810 (offline). Per-point severity is always kept on `vg_sensor_t.severity` (independent of `s_alarm`), so "which points are currently alarming" IS derivable by scanning `vg_model_get_sensors()` for `severity != VG_SEV_OK` / `!online` — `rebuild_filter()` (`vg_model.c:135-175`) already does exactly this for the home filter with a severity-desc sort, and `vg_model_count_by_filter()` (1210) counts alarm/offline/ok.
- Access: `vg_model_get_active_alarm()` (`vg_model.c:1241`), `vg_model_get_sensors(&n)` / `vg_model_get_sensor(id)` / `vg_model_get_primary_sensor()` (vg_model.h:226-228).
- Refresh mechanism: listener registry `s_listeners[VG_MAX_LISTENERS=8]` (`vg_model.c:44`, `notify_all()` 69–74); `vg_model_on_change/off_change` (1244–1266). GUI learns of changes only via this callback + 1 s `lv_timer` → `vg_model_tick()` (1330–1358; board path calls `vg_ui_backend_apply_live()` + `vg_model_board_poll_net()` at 1345–1346). On board, live data comes from the acq thread via `vg_ui_backend_apply_live()` (`app/velaguard/vg_ui_backend_board.c:743-799`) → `vg_model_set_live()` per point.
- Point import: `vg_model_import_runtime_points()` (1560–1630) fills `s_sensors[]` from the confirmed point table; `VG_SENSOR_MAX 64` on board (`vg_model.h:22`).

## 7. Spec docs (.trellis/spec/)

- `/home/hello19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.trellis/spec/frontend/index.md` — index only; its six guideline files (component/state/quality etc.) are all "To fill" placeholders, i.e. no real gui/ conventions documented there.
- `.trellis/spec/guides/index.md` — thinking guides: "Code Reuse Thinking Guide" (search before creating helpers/constants) and "Cross-Layer Thinking Guide" (features spanning layers) — both apply to a model+UI multi-alarm change.
- `.trellis/spec/backend/index.md` — active docs: `vg-config-store.md` (dual-slot FAT config), `firmware-mainline.md` (single product image `velaguard-lvgl`), `host-nsh-protocol.md` (point-table commands). Relevant if you touch the alarm/file side.
- Most important project doc for this task is the skill: `/home/hello19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.agents/skills/velaguard-alarm-to-screen/SKILL.md` — defines the Local Safety Loop contract: alarm rules (`cmp` ge/le/eq, warn/crit, rank crit > offline > warn), HMI clears `s_alarm` + unlinks pending file on recovery, and the acceptance loop (home lists confirmed points, alarm page pops, `pending_alarm.txt` exists). A multi-alarm change must keep this contract (e.g. clear per-point file content when all points recover).

## 8. Build

- Simulator (PC): `gui/CMakeLists.txt` — `file(GLOB_RECURSE VG_UI_SOURCES "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/main/ui/*.c")` (~line 96), so a new `.c` under `gui/main/ui/**` is picked up automatically.
- Firmware: `bash scripts/build.sh` (default target `velaguard-lvgl`) builds NuttX; the GUI is compiled by `/home/hello19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/app/velaguard/Makefile` lines 73–100 under `CONFIG_VG_HMI`:
```make
VG_UI_DIR       := $(VG_CONTEST_ROOT)/gui/main/ui
VG_UI_SUBDIRS   := app shell pages model theme widgets fonts
VG_UI_CSRCS     := $(foreach _d,$(VG_UI_SUBDIRS),$(wildcard $(VG_UI_DIR)/$(_d)/*.c))
VG_UI_CSRCS     := $(filter-out $(VG_UI_DIR)/model/vg_ui_backend.c,$(VG_UI_CSRCS))
CSRCS    += $(notdir $(VG_UI_CSRCS))
CSRCS    += vg_ui_backend_board.c vg_alarm_eval.c
```
  So: new files inside existing subdirs (`pages/`, `model/`, `widgets/`) are auto-compiled; a NEW subdir would have to be appended to `VG_UI_SUBDIRS`. Flags add `-DCONFIG_VG_HMI=1 -DVG_HMI_BOARD=1` and include `gui/main/ui` + `gui/main/inc`. Note the Kconfig mention (`app/velaguard/Kconfig:109`) that `pending_alarm.txt` is "for Agent pickup", and `vg_hmi.c` is the NuttX entry that calls `vg_app_init()`.

The user wants: 告警页 shows multiple alarming points as separate 分栏 (rows/panels), each with 点位 + 摘要, and each row has a 标记处理 button and 静音 button.

Pros: minimal disruption; per-point state natural; no array-of-alarms copy to maintain; duration can be computed per point (alarm_start timestamp per sensor? currently duration only on s_alarm via tick).

147	## Phase Index
148	
149	```
150	Phase 1: Plan    → classify, get task-creation consent, then write planning artifacts
151	Phase 2: Execute → implement only after task status is in_progress
152	Phase 3: Finish  → verify, update spec, commit, and wrap up

154	
155	### Request Triage
156	
157	- Simple conversation or small task: ask only whether this turn should create a Trellis task. If the user says no, skip Trellis for this session.
158	- Complex task: ask whether you may create a Trellis task and enter planning. If the user says no, do not do broad inline implementation; explain, clarify scope, or suggest a smaller split.
159	- User approval to create a task is not approval to start implementation. Planning still happens first.
160	
161	### Planning Artifacts
162	
163	- `prd.md` — requirements, constraints, and acceptance criteria. Do not put technical design or execution checklists here.
164	- `design.md` — technical design for complex tasks: boundaries, contracts, data flow, tradeoffs, compatibility, rollout / rollback shape.
165	- `implement.md` — execution plan for complex tasks: ordered checklist, validation commands, review gates, and rollback points.
166	- `implement.jsonl` / `check.jsonl` — spec and research manifests for sub-agent context. They do not replace `implement.md`.
167	- Lightweight tasks may be PRD-only. Complex tasks must have `prd.md`, `design.md`, and `implement.md` before `task.py start`.
168	
169	### Parent / Child Task Trees
170	
171	Use a parent task when one user request contains several independently verifiable deliverables. The parent task owns the source requirement set, the task map, cross-child acceptance criteria, and final integration review; it normally should not be the implementation target unless it also has direct work.
172	
173	Use child tasks for deliverables that can be planned, implemented, checked, and archived independently. Parent/child structure is not a dependency system: if one child must wait for another, write that ordering in the child `prd.md` / `implement.md` and keep each child's acceptance criteria testable.
174	
175	Create new children with `task.py create "<title>" --slug <name> --parent <parent-dir>`. Link existing tasks with `task.py add-subtask <parent> <child>`, and unlink mistakes with `task.py remove-subtask <parent> <child>`.

# 告警页多分栏显示 + 逐告警处理/静音

## 根因

模型层只有一个全局告警槽 `s_alarm`（`gui/main/ui/model/vg_model.c:39`）。`vg_model_set_live` 里的晋级守卫（阈值路径 `vg_model.c:1733-1749`、离线路径 `:1794-1810`）只允许同点或更高优先级的告警覆盖，同时多点告警时低优先级的直接被丢弃。告警页 `vg_page_alarm.c` 只渲染这一个结构；`pending_alarm.txt` 也由 backend 按单告警写入/清除（`app/velaguard/vg_ui_backend_board.c:768-798`），文件已存在即跳过（`vg_agent_alarm.c:87-90`）。

关键有利条件：每点的告警严重度本来就存在 `vg_sensor_t.severity`，多点告警集合可以直接从点表派生，不需要另建一套告警队列。

## 方案

按已确认的两个决定实施：告警页采用点选分栏看详情；走 Trellis 流程建任务后实施。

### 1. Trellis 任务（Phase 1）

- `task.py create 告警页多分栏显示与逐告警处理静音 --slug alarm-page-multi-rows`，写 `prd.md`（需求与验收）、`design.md`（本方案技术细节）、`implement.md`（执行清单），配置 `implement.jsonl` / `check.jsonl`（SKILL.md、CONTEXT.md、guides），`task.py start` 后进入实施。

### 2. 模型层 gui/main/ui/model/（vg_model.h + vg_model.c）

- `vg_sensor_t` 增加告警期状态：`al_duration_sec`、`al_acked`、`al_muted`。
- 新 API：
  - `vg_model_collect_alarms(out, max)`：扫描所有点，severity 非 OK 的生成 `vg_alarm_t`（标题 = 点名 + 种类、值、阈值、持续、acked/muted），按严重度降序（严重 > 离线 > 预警）。
  - `vg_model_active_alarm_count()`、`vg_model_alarms_all_quieted()`。
  - `vg_model_ack_alarm_id(id)` / `vg_model_mute_alarm_id(id)`（逐点操作）；`vg_model_mute_all_alarms()`（首页快捷静音用）。
- 保留 `vg_model_get_active_alarm()` / `vg_model_ack_alarm()` / `vg_model_mute_alarm()`，语义改为代表主告警（最高优先级），诊断页、状态栏、backend 不需要改语义。
- `vg_model_set_live`：删除两处 rank 晋级守卫；每点从 OK 转入告警时重置该点 al 状态并记告警触发日志，恢复为 NONE 时清该点 al 状态并记恢复日志（替换现有按 s_alarm 属主判断的恢复逻辑）；路径末尾调用新静态函数 `derive_primary_alarm()` 重算主告警（从点表派生，不重置 acked/muted）。
- `vg_model_tick`：对所有告警中的点 `al_duration_sec++`，然后重新派生主告警（保持 value/duration 实时）。
- `apply_scenario` / `import_runtime_points`：移除对 `s_alarm` 的直接 memset 与 `set_alarm_from_sensor` 调用，改为设点级 severity 后派生；点表重灌时 al 状态随 memset 自然清零。

### 3. 告警页 gui/main/ui/pages/vg_page_alarm.c（重写刷新逻辑）

- head 卡：活动告警 N 个 / 无活动告警 + 主告警严重度 chip。
- body 滚动区内分两段：
  - 分栏列表：每个活动告警一栏，复用首页 tile 视觉（严重度左边框、斑马底、最小触高 36px）。每栏两行：行 1 为点名 + 小号严重度 chip + 右侧静音、标记处理两个小按钮（已处理/已静音后禁用）；行 2 为摘要（阈值类显示 当前值 vs 阈值 + 持续秒数，离线显示 通信离线 + 持续秒数）。行可点击选中，选中行高亮；点击按钮调 `*_alarm_id` 并 toast，不触发选中。列表重建沿用首页的 signature 模式：签名（数量 + id 集 + severity）变了才重建，文本每帧就地刷新。
  - 详情区（绑定选中分栏）：现有规则摘要、6 行指标、历史原样保留，数据源换成选中告警；无选中或选中失效时回落到列表第一栏。
- 底部全局 actions 行移除（按钮进分栏）。
- 术语约束：标记处理只记录已知晓（CONTEXT.md Acknowledgement ≠ Resolution），分栏保留到恢复条件满足，状态列显示已处理。

### 4. pending_alarm.txt（app/velaguard/vg_ui_backend_board.c）

- 格式保持单条记录不变（Agent alarm_interpretation seed 与 README 示例不动），文件内容 = 主告警。
- 写入逻辑改为：有活动告警且文件缺失或主告警 id/类型变化时先 clear 再 write；活动告警数归零才 clear（修复当前任一点恢复就整文件删除的问题）。

### 5. 状态栏 / 首页 / 诊断页适配

- `vg_shell.c` refresh_alarm_chip：chip 严重度取主告警；变暗条件改为全部活动告警均已 acked/muted。
- `vg_page_home.c` on_mute：静音全部活动告警，toast 提示数量；无告警提示保持不变。
- `vg_page_diagnosis.c`：不改（no-arg ack 继续作用于主告警）。

### 6. 验证

- host 回归：`make -C app/velaguard/host_tests test`。
- PC 模拟器冒烟（gui/CMakeLists）：切 WARN/CRIT/OFFLINE 场景（种子本身含多点告警），核对分栏布局、点选详情、按钮态、480x272 无溢出。
- 板端闭环（build.sh → QSPI 烧录 → COM3 NSH）：两点同时越限（或一越限一拔线）出现 2 栏；逐栏处理/静音互不影响；单点恢复该栏消失且 pending 文件仍在（内容为剩余主告警）；全部恢复后无活动告警且文件消失；Agent heartbeat 解读流程不受影响。

### 7. 收尾

- 更新 `.agents/skills/velaguard-alarm-to-screen/SKILL.md`：补多告警语义（分栏、pending = 主告警记录、全部恢复才 unlink）。
- trellis-check → trellis-update-spec → 按 Phase 3.4 分批提交 → /trellis:finish-work。

## 明确不做

- pending_alarm.txt 多记录格式（Agent 契约与现有格式保持不变）
- 静音接蜂鸣器/音频联动（现状无音频路径）
- 新增 Recovering 告警种类（代码无此 kind）
- 标记处理即消除告警（与 CONTEXT.md 术语口径冲突）

## 风险

- 告警页重写是最大改动，用首页已验证的 signature 重建模式降低风险。
- 场景种子的告警标题从定制文案变为生成文案（如 温度 点表预警），模拟器冒烟时确认可接受。

# 告警页多分栏显示与逐告警处理静音

## Goal

多个点位同时告警时,告警页逐点分栏显示,每栏展示点位与摘要,并各自提供标记处理与静音按钮;替代当前只显示单条告警的行为。

## Background / Problem

- 现状:模型层只有单个全局告警槽 `s_alarm`(gui/main/ui/model/vg_model.c:39),`vg_model_set_live` 的晋级守卫(阈值 1733-1749、离线 1794-1810)使同时多点告警只保留最高优先级一条,其余被丢弃。
- 告警页(vg_page_alarm.c)只渲染这一条;`pending_alarm.txt` 由 backend 按单告警写入,任一点恢复即整文件删除。
- 用户要求:多点同时告警时告警页分栏同时显示,分栏内容为点位与摘要,每栏带标记处理按钮和静音按钮。

## Requirements

- R1 告警页:每个活动告警一个分栏,含点位名、摘要(当前值 vs 阈值 + 持续时间;离线显示通信离线 + 持续时间)、标记处理按钮、静音按钮。
- R2 分栏按严重度降序排列(严重 > 离线 > 预警),与 `vg_alarm_kind_rank` 口径一致。
- R3 已确认的交互方案:点选分栏在下方详情区显示该点完整告警详情(规则摘要、类型/当前值/阈值/持续/传感器/状态 6 行指标、历史),默认选中最高优先级分栏。
- R4 标记处理为逐点操作:仅目标分栏状态变为已处理并禁用其按钮,不影响其他分栏。
- R5 静音为逐点操作:仅目标分栏进入已静音状态;状态栏告警 chip 在全部活动告警均被处理或静音后才变暗。
- R6 术语遵循 CONTEXT.md:标记处理只记录已知晓(Acknowledgement != Resolution),分栏保留到恢复条件满足。
- R7 `pending_alarm.txt`:保持单条记录格式与 Agent 契约不变,内容为主告警;全部活动告警恢复后才删除文件。
- R8 首页快捷静音作用于全部活动告警;诊断页维持现状(作用于主告警)。

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1 两点同时越限(或一越限一离线)时,告警页出现 2 个分栏,各含点位名、摘要、标记处理、静音按钮。
- [ ] AC2 标记处理其中一栏,该栏显示已处理且按钮禁用,另一栏不受影响。
- [ ] AC3 静音另一栏后,状态栏告警 chip 变暗;仅处理/静音一部分时 chip 保持醒目。
- [ ] AC4 点击分栏,详情区切换为该点的规则摘要、指标行、历史数据。
- [ ] AC5 单点恢复正常后该分栏消失,其余分栏仍在,`/data/velaguard/pending_alarm.txt` 仍存在且内容为剩余主告警。
- [ ] AC6 全部告警恢复后,告警页显示无活动告警,`pending_alarm.txt` 被删除。
- [ ] AC7 `make -C app/velaguard/host_tests test` 全绿;PC 模拟器场景冒烟通过;板端固件编译通过。

## Constraints

- 本地安全环契约不变:告警不依赖 MQTT/Agent;Agent heartbeat 解读 pending 文件的流程不受影响。
- 不新增 Recovering 告警种类;不接蜂鸣器;pending_alarm.txt 不改多记录格式。
- 屏幕为 480x272,最小触高 36px,布局不得溢出。

# Design: 告警页多分栏显示与逐告警处理静音

## 根因

模型层单告警槽 `s_alarm`(gui/main/ui/model/vg_model.c:39)配合 `vg_model_set_live` 的 rank 晋级守卫(阈值 1733-1749、离线 1794-1810),同时多点告警只保留最高优先级一条。每点的告警严重度本就存在 `vg_sensor_t.severity`,多点告警集合可直接从点表派生。

## 总体思路

告警期状态(acked/muted/时长)下沉到点级(`vg_sensor_t` 新字段);多点告警列表由模型按点表扫描派生;`s_alarm` 保留但语义变为主告警(最高优先级)的派生视图,所有既有单告警消费方(状态栏 chip、诊断页、backend pending 写入)语义不变。

## 1. 模型层 gui/main/ui/model/

### vg_model.h

- `vg_sensor_t` 新增:`int32_t al_duration_sec; bool al_acked; bool al_muted;`
- 新 API:
  - `uint16_t vg_model_collect_alarms(vg_alarm_t * out, uint16_t max)` — 扫描 `s_sensors[]`,severity 非 OK 的点生成 `vg_alarm_t`(title = 点名 + 种类、value、threshold 按 kind 取 warn/crit、duration、acked/muted、sensor_id),按 rank 降序填充,返回条数。rank 用 `vg_alarm_kind_rank` 映射(crit=3 > offline=2 > warn=1)。
  - `uint16_t vg_model_active_alarm_count(void)`
  - `bool vg_model_alarms_all_quieted(void)` — 有活动告警且每条均 acked||muted
  - `void vg_model_ack_alarm_id(const char * id)` / `void vg_model_mute_alarm_id(const char * id)` — 逐点置位 + 日志(带点名) + notify
  - `void vg_model_mute_all_alarms(void)` — 全部活动告警置 muted(首页快捷静音)
- 保留:`vg_model_get_active_alarm()`(返回派生主告警,指针仍为 `&s_alarm` 稳定地址,契约不破)、`vg_model_ack_alarm()` / `vg_model_mute_alarm()`(作用于主告警 id)。

### vg_model.c

- 新静态 `derive_primary_alarm()`:扫描出 rank 最高的告警点,从点级状态填 `s_alarm`(active/severity/title/value/threshold/duration/acked/muted/sensor_id),不重置 acked/muted;无告警则 memset。替代 `set_alarm_from_sensor`。
- `vg_model_set_live` 阈值路径(1664-1762):
  - 删除 rank 晋级守卫(1733-1749)。
  - kind != NONE 且该点此前非告警(transition)→ 重置 al_acked/al_muted=false、al_duration_sec=0,记日志 告警触发: 点名。
  - kind == NONE 且该点此前告警 → 清 al 状态,记日志 告警恢复: 点名(替换 1707-1715 按 s_alarm 属主的恢复判断)。
  - severity 照旧写 `s->severity`(1728-1731)。
  - 路径末尾 changed 时 `derive_primary_alarm()`。
- `vg_model_set_live` 离线路径(1763-1821):同样处理 offline transition/恢复,删除 1794-1810 守卫。
- `vg_model_tick`(1330-1358):对所有 severity 非 OK 的点 `al_duration_sec++`,随后 `derive_primary_alarm()`(替换 1349-1354 的单告警镜像)。
- `apply_scenario`(1026+):移除 `memset(&s_alarm)` 与 `set_alarm_from_sensor` 调用;种子设置 severity 后调 `derive_primary_alarm()`;日志引用 s_alarm.title 不变。场景标题从定制文案变为生成文案(温度 点表预警 等)。
- `vg_model_import_runtime_points`(1560-1630):移除 1623-1626 的 s_alarm 特判(import 循环 memset(s) 已清 al 状态),末尾 derive;n<=0 分支的 memset 保留。
- 派生重建签名:无。派生每次全扫,点数上限 64,代价可忽略;全部调用发生在 LVGL 线程(set_live 由 tick 的 apply_live 调用),无线程安全问题。

## 2. 告警页 gui/main/ui/pages/vg_page_alarm.c(重写)

布局(480x272,内容高约 232):

- head 卡 36px:`活动告警 N 个` / `无活动告警` + 主告警严重度 chip(沿用 vg_status_chip)。
- body 滚动卡(flex_grow=1,竖向滚动):
  - 分栏列表:每活动告警一栏,复用首页 tile 视觉(严重度左边框 4px、斑马底、最小触高 36px)。栏内两行:
    - 行1:点名(ui font)+ 小号严重度 chip + 右侧按钮 静音 / 标记处理(小尺寸,约 56/88 宽 x 36 高;acked/muted 后 DISABLED)。
    - 行2(small font):阈值类 `76.2℃ ≥ 75.0℃ · 持续 120s`;离线 `通信离线 · 持续 300s`;ack/muted 追加状态词。
    - 栏 CLICKABLE,点击设选中;按钮点击不冒泡(子控件命中即截停,不设 EVENT_BUBBLE)。
    - 选中栏高亮(边框/底色)。
  - 详情区:现有 ai_head/ai_lab、6 行 vg_metric_row、hist_lab 原样保留,数据源改为选中告警;规则摘要保持本地规则引擎口径文案。
- 底部全局 actions 行删除(按钮进分栏)。
- 结构重建沿用首页 signature 模式:签名 = 分栏数量 + id 集 + severity 集;签名变化才重建行,文本每帧就地刷新(vg_model_on_change 回调 refresh,1s tick 兜底)。
- 选中状态:ctx 增 `char sel_id[VG_SENSOR_ID_MAX]`;选中点恢复后回落到列表第一栏。
- 数据获取:refresh 里 `vg_model_collect_alarms(list, VG_ALARM_LIST_MAX)`(栈上数组,上限取 8;超出按 rank 截断,状态栏计数用 active_alarm_count 仍显示真实总数)。
- 空状态:无活动告警时列表隐藏、详情区显示占位文案、chip 正常。

## 3. pending_alarm.txt — app/velaguard/vg_ui_backend_board.c:768-798

- 格式不变(单条记录,type/tag/slave/reg/value/threshold/hint),内容 = 主告警;Agent alarm_interpretation seed 与 README 示例不动。
- 逻辑改为:
  - `vg_model_active_alarm_count() > 0`:主告警 sensor_id+type 组成 tag;若与上次写入 tag 不同(或首写)→ `vg_pending_alarm_clear()` + `vg_pending_alarm_write(body)`。Agent 删文件后下一次 apply_live 会因文件缺失重写(保留 write_pending 的 exists-noop 去重,首写判断用 stat 缺失 || tag 变化)。
  - 计数 == 0 且上次 > 0 → `vg_pending_alarm_clear()`(修复任一点恢复即删整文件的问题)。

## 4. 状态栏 / 首页 / 诊断页

- vg_shell.c refresh_alarm_chip(288-317):chip 严重度取主告警;变暗条件改为 `vg_model_alarms_all_quieted()`。
- vg_page_home.c on_mute(313-325):改调 `vg_model_mute_all_alarms()`,toast 提示数量(如 已静音 3 个告警);无告警时保持 当前无活动告警。
- vg_page_diagnosis.c:不改。

## 5. 权衡与备选

- 备选 A(未选):模型维护 `vg_alarm_t[]` 告警队列 — 需要增删去重与同步,结构churn更大;点级状态 + 派生复用既有 severity,改动集中。
- 备选 B(未选):pending 文件改多记录 — 需同步改 Agent seed/skill 解析,超出本次 UI 范围。
- 风险:告警页重写为最大改动,用首页已验证的 signature 重建模式;场景种子标题文案变化需冒烟确认。

## 6. 回滚

- 单任务分支上按提交粒度 revert;模型层与 UI 改动分提交,可独立回退 UI 先行。

# Thinking Guides

> **Purpose**: Expand your thinking to catch things you might not have considered.

---

## Why Thinking Guides?

**Most bugs and tech debt come from "didn't think of that"**, not from lack of skill:

- Didn't think about what happens at layer boundaries → cross-layer bugs
- Didn't think about code patterns repeating → duplicated code everywhere
- Didn't think about edge cases → runtime errors
- Didn't think about future maintainers → unreadable code

These guides help you **ask the right questions before coding**.

---

## Available Guides

| Guide | Purpose | When to Use |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| [Code Reuse Thinking Guide](./code-reuse-thinking-guide.md) | Identify patterns and reduce duplication | When you notice repeated patterns |
| [Cross-Layer Thinking Guide](./cross-layer-thinking-guide.md) | Think through data flow across layers | Features spanning multiple layers |

---

## Quick Reference: Thinking Triggers

### When to Think About Cross-Layer Issues

- [ ] Feature touches 3+ layers (API, Service, Component, Database)
- [ ] Data format changes between layers
- [ ] Multiple consumers need the same data
- [ ] You're not sure where to put some logic
- [ ] You are adding an event kind, JSONL record, RPC payload, or config field
- [ ] UI / command code starts casting raw payload fields directly

→ Read [Cross-Layer Thinking Guide](./cross-layer-thinking-guide.md)

### When to Think About Code Reuse

- [ ] You're writing similar code to something that exists
- [ ] You see the same pattern repeated 3+ times
- [ ] You're adding a new field to multiple places
- [ ] **You're modifying any constant or config**
- [ ] **You're creating a new utility/helper function** ← Search first!
- [ ] Two files read the same untyped payload field with local casts
- [ ] Multiple branches update the same derived state from `kind` / `action`

→ Read [Code Reuse Thinking Guide](./code-reuse-thinking-guide.md)

### When Verifying AI Cross-Review Results

- [ ] Reviewer claims "user input can be malicious" → Check the actual data source (internal manifest? user config? external API?)
- [ ] Reviewer flags "missing validation" → Is the data from a trusted internal source?
- [ ] Reviewer says "behavior change" → Read the code comments — is it intentional design?
- [ ] Reviewer identifies a "bug" in test → Mentally delete the feature being tested — does the test still pass? If yes → tautological test

**Common AI reviewer false-positive patterns**:
1. **Trust boundary confusion**: Treating internal data (bundled JSON manifests) as untrusted external input
2. **Ignoring design comments**: Flagging intentional behavior documented in code comments as bugs
3. **Variable misreading**: Not tracing a variable to its actual definition (e.g., Map keyed by path vs name)

**Verification rule**: Every CRITICAL/WARNING finding must be verified against the actual code before prioritizing. Budget ~35% false-positive rate for AI reviews.

---

## Pre-Modification Rule (CRITICAL)

> **Before changing ANY value, ALWAYS search first!**

```bash
# Search for the value you're about to change
grep -r "value_to_change" .
```

This single habit prevents most "forgot to update X" bugs.

---

## How to Use This Directory

1. **Before coding**: Skim the relevant thinking guide
2. **During coding**: If something feels repetitive or complex, check the guides
3. **After bugs**: Add new insights to the relevant guide (learn from mistakes)

---

## Contributing

Found a new "didn't think of that" moment? Add it to the relevant guide.

---

**Core Principle**: 30 minutes of thinking saves 3 hours of debugging.

# 板端内环：preset、验收脚本、COM

先读本 Skill 的 SKILL.md。这里只放对照表。

## preset

`scripts/build.sh` 把 `velaguard` / `velaguard-lvgl` / `net` 都归一成作品主线 `velaguard-lvgl`。

| 参数 | defconfig | 何时用 |
|------|-----------|--------|
| （默认）/ `velaguard` / `net` | `velaguard-lvgl` | 作品主线（LVGL + 网 + discover + Agent 已链接） |
| `min` | `velaguard-min` | 无屏无网的 bring-up |
| `emmc` | `velaguard-emmc` | eMMC / `/data` 探针 |
| `ai-probe` | `velaguard-ai-probe` | Agent 可行性探针 |
| `lvgl` | 上游 `lvgl` | 不要当作品主线 |

`--clean` 会 `configure.sh -E` 复位到所选预设，未 `savedefconfig` 的 `.config` 改动会丢掉。

产物：`nuttx/nuttx.hex`、`nuttx/nuttx.bin`，并暂存到选手仓 `.debug/`。Download / `flash.ps1` 烧 `.debug` 里的 HEX。

## 验收脚本怎么选

一律：

```text
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/<name>.ps1
```

默认串口 COM3、115200 8N1，提示符 `nsh>`。

| 本次改动 | 脚本 |
|----------|------|
| 编完要烧再抽检开机 | `stage1_flash_and_accept.ps1`（先占 COM3，再 `flash.ps1`，再等 boot） |
| 只烧、不跑 NSH 套件 | `flash.ps1` |
| 点表 / discover / 总线 | `stage1_modbus_discovery_accept.ps1` |
| HMI / LVGL 页面 | `stage1_lvgl_hmi_accept.ps1` |
| Agent 集成（不含本 Skill 必跑的 `ask`） | `stage1_agent_accept.ps1` |
| 网口 / MQTT 最小环 | `stage1_net_full_accept.ps1` |
| 运营 Skill / 日报落盘 | `stage1_agent_ops_accept.ps1` |
| 阶段 0 bring-up | `stage0_accept.ps1` |

对应 `*_accept_nsh.txt` 是手工 NSH 步骤，脚本不可用时按文件做。

Host 单测不占串口：`make -C app/velaguard/host_tests test`。

## COM 占用

1. 先关 Cursor 串口监视器、SSCOM、其它 `SerialPort` 占用。
2. 优先 `stage1_flash_and_accept.ps1`：它先打开 COM3 再烧，避免烧完被监视器抢走。
3. 仍被占：查占用进程，能杀则杀，再重跑脚本。
4. 杀不掉或口不是 COM3：停下来告诉用户，不要假装板测通过。

# Stage1 LVGL HMI board accept (velaguard-lvgl = net+HMI @ COM3).
#   powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage1_lvgl_hmi_accept.ps1

param(
  [string]$ComPort = "COM3",
  [int]$Baud = 115200,
  [string]$Log = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$script:pass = 0
$script:fail = 0

function Send-Serial {
  param(
    [System.IO.Ports.SerialPort]$Port,
    [string]$Cmd,
    [int]$WaitSec = 12
  )
  $Port.DiscardInBuffer()
  $Port.Write("$Cmd`r")
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400
  $buf = ""
  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($WaitSec)
  while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
    if ($Port.BytesToRead -gt 0) { $buf += $Port.ReadExisting() }
    if ($buf -match "nsh>") { break }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80
  }
  Write-Host "`n=== $Cmd ==="
  Write-Host $buf
  return $buf
}

function Assert-Match {
  param([string]$Name, [string]$Hay, [string]$Pattern)
  if ($Hay -match $Pattern) {
    Write-Host "[PASS] $Name"
    $script:pass++
  } else {
    Write-Host "[FAIL] $Name (pattern: $Pattern)"
    $script:fail++
  }
}

$port = New-Object System.IO.Ports.SerialPort
$port.PortName = $ComPort
$port.BaudRate = $Baud
$port.ReadTimeout = 8000
$port.DtrEnable = $true

  [int]$ComPort = 4,
  [int]$Baud = 9600,

)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Get-SafeSensorName([string]$Name) {
  $n = $Name -replace '^\[S\]', ''
  $n = $n.Trim()
  foreach ($c in @('<', '>', ':', '"', '/', '\', '|', '?', '*')) {
    $n = $n.Replace($c, '_')
  }
  $n = $n -replace '\s+', ''
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($n)) { $n = 'sensor' }
  return $n
}

function Resolve-SlaveMbs([string]$Root, [int]$Addr, [string]$Name) {
  $safe = Get-SafeSensorName $Name
  $named = Join-Path $Root ("{0:D2}_{1}.mbs" -f $Addr, $safe)
  if (Test-Path $named) { return $named }
  $legacy = Join-Path $Root ("velaguard_slave{0:D2}.mbs" -f $Addr)
  if (Test-Path $legacy) { return $legacy }
  return $null
}

# Temp NSH evidence check for multi-alarm acceptance (deleted after use).
param(
  [string]$ComPort = "COM3",
  [int]$Baud = 115200
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Send-Serial {
  param(
    [System.IO.Ports.SerialPort]$Port,
    [string]$Cmd,
    [int]$WaitSec = 15
  )
  $Port.DiscardInBuffer()
  $Port.Write("$Cmd`r")
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400
  $buf = ""
  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($WaitSec)
  while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
    if ($Port.BytesToRead -gt 0) { $buf += $Port.ReadExisting() }
    if ($buf -match "nsh>") { break }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80
  }
  Write-Host "`n=== $Cmd ==="
  Write-Host $buf
  return $buf
}

$port = New-Object System.IO.Ports.SerialPort
$port.PortName = $ComPort
$port.BaudRate = $Baud
$port.ReadTimeout = 8000
$port.DtrEnable = $true
$port.Open()
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600
$port.DiscardInBuffer()

$null = Send-Serial $port "vgpoint list"
$null = Send-Serial $port "vgpoint get" 20
$null = Send-Serial $port "ls -l /data/velaguard/pending_alarm.txt"
$null = Send-Serial $port "cat /data/velaguard/pending_alarm.txt"

$port.Close()
Write-Host "`n[nsh-check] done"

import struct, zlib, glob
def ppm2png(p):
    with open(p,'rb') as f: data=f.read()
    parts=data.split(b'\n',3); w,h=map(int,parts[1].split()); raw=parts[3]
    rows=b''.join(b'\x00'+raw[y*w*3:(y+1)*w*3] for y in range(h))
    def chunk(t,d):
        c=struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d; return c+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    png=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(rows,6))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
    open(p[:-4]+'.png','wb').write(png)
for p in sorted(glob.glob('.debug/headless/shots/*.ppm')): ppm2png(p)
print("png ok")
EOF

<skill_content name="trellis-check">
# Skill: trellis-check
# Code Quality Check

Comprehensive quality verification for recently written code. Combines spec compliance, cross-layer safety, and pre-commit checks.

---

## Step 1: Identify What Changed

```bash
git diff --name-only HEAD
git status
```

## Step 2: Read Task Artifacts and Applicable Specs

Read the current task artifacts in order:

- `prd.md`
- `design.md` if present
- `implement.md` if present

```bash
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/get_context.py --mode packages
```

For each changed package/layer, read the spec index and follow its **Quality Check** section:

```bash
cat .trellis/spec/<package>/<layer>/index.md
```

Read the specific guideline files referenced — the index is a pointer, not the goal.

## Step 3: Run Project Checks

Run the project's lint, type-check, and test commands. Fix any failures before proceeding.

## Step 4: Review Against Checklist

### Code Quality

- [ ] Linter passes?
- [ ] Type checker passes (if applicable)?
- [ ] Tests pass?
- [ ] No debug logging left in?
- [ ] No suppressed warnings or type-safety bypasses?

### Test Coverage

- [ ] New function → unit test added?
- [ ] Bug fix → regression test added?
- [ ] Changed behavior → existing tests updated?

### Spec Sync

- [ ] Does `.trellis/spec/` need updates? (new patterns, conventions, lessons learned)

> "If I fixed a bug or discovered something non-obvious, should I document it so future me won't hit the same issue?" → If YES, update the relevant spec doc.

### Scope Discipline

- [ ] Any tidying of code the task did not require?
- [ ] Any abstraction, config or extension point added for a case that does not exist yet?
- [ ] Any speculative fallback for a state that cannot occur?
- [ ] Any file changed that the acceptance criteria do not mention?
- [ ] Any workaround added at the caller instead of a fix where the behavior actually lives?

## Step 5: Cross-Layer Dimensions (if applicable)

Skip this step if your change is confined to a single layer.

### A. Data Flow (changes touch 3+ layers)

- [ ] Read flow traces correctly: Storage → Service → API → UI
- [ ] Write flow traces correctly: UI → API → Service → Storage
- [ ] Types/schemas correctly passed between layers?
- [ ] Errors properly propagated to caller?

### B. Code Reuse (modifying constants, creating utilities)

- [ ] Searched for existing similar code before creating new?
  ```bash
  grep -r "pattern" src/
  ```
- [ ] If the same value repeats, does it represent one stable concept whose callers must change together? Extract only then — two literals that merely happen to match today should stay separate.
- [ ] After batch modification, all occurrences updated?

### C. Import/Dependency (creating new files)

- [ ] Correct import paths (relative vs absolute)?
- [ ] No circular dependencies?

### D. Same-Layer Consistency

- [ ] Other places using the same concept are consistent?

---

## Step 6: Report and Fix

Report every violation you find. Then:

- Mechanical and local (lint nit, missing type, wrong import, dead branch, failing assertion) → fix in place, then re-run project checks.
- Design or judgment (naming a shared concept, moving a module boundary, changing a public interface, reassigning where behavior lives) → record the evidence and your recommendation, and stop. Do not rewrite it silently.

If a fix would touch files outside the current task's scope, say so and stop instead of widening the change.

<skill_content name="trellis-update-spec">
# Skill: trellis-update-spec
# Update Code-Spec - Capture Executable Contracts

When you learn something valuable (from debugging, implementing, or discussion), use this to update the relevant code-spec documents.

**Timing**: After completing a task, fixing a bug, or discovering a new pattern

---

## Code-Spec First Rule (CRITICAL)

In this project, "spec" for implementation work means **code-spec**:
- Executable contracts (not principle-only text)
- Concrete signatures, payload fields, env keys, and boundary behavior
- Testable validation/error behavior

If the change touches infra or cross-layer contracts, code-spec depth is mandatory.

### Mandatory Triggers

Apply code-spec depth when the change includes any of:
- New/changed command or API signature
- Cross-layer request/response contract change
- Database schema/migration change
- Infra integration (storage, queue, cache, secrets, env wiring)

### Mandatory Output (7 Sections)

For triggered tasks, include all sections below:
1. Scope / Trigger
2. Signatures (command/API/DB)
3. Contracts (request/response/env)
4. Validation & Error Matrix
5. Good/Base/Bad Cases
6. Tests Required (with assertion points)
7. Wrong vs Correct (at least one pair)

---

## When to Update Code-Specs

| Trigger | Example | Target Spec |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| **Implemented a feature** | Added a new integration or module | Relevant spec file |
| **Made a design decision** | Chose extensibility pattern over simplicity | Relevant spec + "Design Decisions" section |
| **Fixed a bug** | Found a subtle issue with error handling | Relevant spec (e.g., error-handling docs) |
| **Discovered a pattern** | Found a better way to structure code | Relevant spec file |
| **Hit a gotcha** | Learned that X must be done before Y | Relevant spec + "Common Mistakes" section |
| **Established a convention** | Team agreed on naming pattern | Quality guidelines |
| **New thinking trigger** | "Don't forget to check X before doing Y" | `guides/*.md` (as a checklist item) |

**Key Insight**: Code-spec updates are NOT just for problems. Every feature implementation contains design decisions and contracts that future AI/developers need to execute safely.

---

## Spec Structure Overview

```
.trellis/spec/
├── <layer>/           # Per-layer coding standards (e.g., backend/, frontend/, api/)
│   ├── index.md       # Overview and links
│   └── *.md           # Topic-specific guidelines
└── guides/            # Thinking checklists (NOT coding specs!)
    ├── index.md       # Guide index
    └── *.md           # Topic-specific guides
```

### CRITICAL: Code-Spec vs Guide - Know the Difference

| Type | Location | Purpose | Content Style |
|------|----------|---------|---------------|
| **Code-Spec** | `<layer>/*.md` | Tell AI "how to implement safely" | Signatures, contracts, matrices, cases, test points |
| **Guide** | `guides/*.md` | Help AI "what to think about" | Checklists, questions, pointers to specs |

**Decision Rule**: Ask yourself:

- "This is **how to write** the code" → Put in a spec layer directory
- "This is **what to consider** before writing" → Put in `guides/`

**Example**:

| Learning | Wrong Location | Correct Location |
|----------|----------------|------------------|
| "Use API X not API Y for this task" | ❌ `guides/` (too specific for a thinking guide) | ✅ Relevant spec file (concrete convention) |
| "Remember to check X when doing Y" | ❌ Spec file (too abstract for a spec) | ✅ `guides/` (thinking checklist) |

**Guides should be short checklists that point to specs**, not duplicate the detailed rules.

---

## Update Process

### Step 1: Identify What You Learned

Answer these questions:

1. **What did you learn?** (Be specific)
2. **Why is it important?** (What problem does it prevent?)
3. **Where does it belong?** (Which spec file?)

### Step 2: Classify the Update Type

| Type | Description | Action |
|------|-------------|--------|
| **Design Decision** | Why we chose approach X over Y | Add to "Design Decisions" section |
| **Project Convention** | How we do X in this project | Add to relevant section with examples |
| **New Pattern** | A reusable approach discovered | Add to "Patterns" section |
| **Forbidden Pattern** | Something that causes problems | Add to "Anti-patterns" or "Don't" section |
| **Common Mistake** | Easy-to-make error | Add to "Common Mistakes" section |
| **Convention** | Agreed-upon standard | Add to relevant section |
| **Gotcha** | Non-obvious behavior | Add warning callout |

### Step 3: Read the Target Code-Spec

Before editing, read the current code-spec to:
- Understand existing structure
- Avoid duplicating content
- Find the right section for your update

```bash
cat .trellis/spec/<category>/<file>.md
```

### Step 4: Make the Update

Follow these principles:

1. **Be Specific**: Include concrete examples, not just abstract rules
2. **Explain Why**: State the problem this prevents
3. **Show Contracts**: Add signatures, payload fields, and error behavior
4. **Show Code**: Add code snippets for key patterns
5. **Keep it Short**: One concept per section

### Step 5: Update the Index (if needed)

If you added a new section or the code-spec status changed, update the category's `index.md`.

---

## Update Templates

### Mandatory Template for Infra/Cross-Layer Work

```markdown
## Scenario: <name>

### 1. Scope / Trigger
- Trigger: <why this requires code-spec depth>

### 2. Signatures
- Backend command/API/DB signature(s)

### 3. Contracts
- Request fields (name, type, constraints)
- Response fields (name, type, constraints)
- Environment keys (required/optional)

### 4. Validation & Error Matrix
- <condition> -> <error>

### 5. Good/Base/Bad Cases
- Good: ...
- Base: ...
- Bad: ...

### 6. Tests Required
- Unit/Integration/E2E with assertion points

### 7. Wrong vs Correct
#### Wrong
...
#### Correct
...
```

### Adding a Design Decision

```markdown
### Design Decision: [Decision Name]

**Context**: What problem were we solving?

**Options Considered**:
1. Option A - brief description
2. Option B - brief description

**Decision**: We chose Option X because...

**Example**:
\`\`\`typescript
// How it's implemented
code example
\`\`\`

**Extensibility**: How to extend this in the future...
```

### Adding a Project Convention

```markdown
### Convention: [Convention Name]

**What**: Brief description of the convention.

**Why**: Why we do it this way in this project.

**Example**:
\`\`\`typescript
// How to follow this convention
code example
\`\`\`

**Related**: Links to related conventions or specs.
```

### Adding a New Pattern

```markdown
### Pattern Name

**Problem**: What problem does this solve?

**Solution**: Brief description of the approach.

**Example**:
\`\`\`
// Good
code example

// Bad
code example
\`\`\`

**Why**: Explanation of why this works better.
```

### Adding a Forbidden Pattern

```markdown
### Don't: Pattern Name

**Problem**:
\`\`\`
// Don't do this
bad code example
\`\`\`

**Why it's bad**: Explanation of the issue.

**Instead**:
\`\`\`
// Do this instead
good code example
\`\`\`
```

### Adding a Common Mistake

```markdown
### Common Mistake: Description

**Symptom**: What goes wrong
```

## Common Mistakes

<!-- Component-related mistakes your team has made -->

### Common Mistake: plain `lv_obj` containers swallow taps meant for a clickable parent card

**Symptom**: A clickable card row (e.g. an alarm row with an `on_row_click` handler) never receives `LV_EVENT_CLICKED`; buttons inside it still work. The row shows only its default/derived state.

**Cause**: In LVGL 9, objects created with `lv_obj_create()` carry `LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE` by default. A plain container laid out inside the card (a header line, an inner flex box) is itself clickable, sits on top of the card, and intercepts the press-release, so the card handler never fires.

**Fix**: Clear the flag on every plain container inside a clickable card:

```c
line1 = lv_obj_create(row);
lv_obj_remove_flag(line1, LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLLABLE);
/* plain containers are clickable by default in LVGL 9; let taps fall
 * through to the row card so the whole row selects */
lv_obj_clear_flag(line1, LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE);
```

Also clear it on composite widgets that are not meant to be tapped (e.g. a `vg_status_chip` inside the row). Buttons (`lv_button`) keep their own handlers and stay clickable.

**Prevention**: When building a tappable card from nested containers, list every child container and either give it a handler or clear `LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE`. Verify with the headless render harness (`gui/headless/alarm_check_main.c`), which drives the real pointer indev and asserts the state change actually happened.

---

### Pattern: headless render harness for LVGL pages (no SDL, no board)

**Problem**: The SDL simulator needs libsdl2 (absent in WSL) and board acceptance cannot show pixel-level UI state.

**Solution**: `gui/headless/alarm_check_main.c` builds the real UI into a 480x272 off-screen buffer, drives a scripted pointer indev (clicks located by widget text, so they survive layout changes), dumps frames as PPM (convert to PNG for inspection), and prints model-level PASS/FAIL lines. It is excluded from both the firmware build (app/velaguard Makefile globs `gui/main/ui/{app,shell,pages,model,theme,widgets,fonts}` only) and the SDL sim (CMake globs `main/ui` only).

Key implementation facts (LVGL 9.3):
- `lv_color_t` is always 3-byte RGB888 now; the display buffer is XRGB8888 (4 bytes). In `flush_cb` decode with the display color format and `lv_draw_buf_width_to_stride()` — do not iterate `lv_color_t` over the render buffer.
- `lv_indev_create()` takes no arguments in 9.3; use `lv_indev_set_type()` + `lv_indev_set_read_cb()`.

**When to use**: any page-layout or interaction change to `gui/main/ui` before flashing the board.

## 结果

多点同时告警的显示问题已修复并验证。根因是模型层只有一个全局告警槽 `s_alarm`，同时多点告警时只保留优先级最高的一条，其余直接丢弃。改动分四层：

- **模型层**（vg_model.h/.c）：告警期状态（是否活动、已处理、已静音、持续秒数）下沉到每个点位，新增 `vg_model_collect_alarms`（按严重 > 离线 > 预警排序收集全部活动告警）、按 id 的逐点处理/静音 API；`s_alarm` 保留为主告警的派生视图，诊断页、OTA 拦截等既有单告警消费方语义不变。
- **告警页**（vg_page_alarm.c 重写）：每个活动告警一个分栏，含点名、摘要（当前值/阈值/持续时间，离线则显示通信离线）、静音和标记处理按钮；点选分栏后下方详情区（规则摘要、6 行指标、历史）切换到该点并滚入视野，默认选中最高优先级。分栏重建沿用首页的签名模式，文本每秒就地刷新。
- **落盘**（vg_ui_backend_board.c）：`pending_alarm.txt` 仍为单条主告警记录（Agent 契约与格式不变），主告警换点或换种类时重写；只有全部告警恢复才删文件，修复了原先任一点恢复就清空文件的问题。
- **状态栏/首页**：告警 chip 在全部告警均被处理或静音后才变暗；首页快捷静音改为作用于全部活动告警。
